dedupe_keys.name: estadisticas agricolas de las unidades de riego conagua irrigation unit agricultural statistics mexico

description: CONAGUA, Mexico's national water commission, publishes yearly agricultural statistics for the irrigation units (unidades de riego), the smaller user-run irrigation schemes outside the large irrigation districts. The document page read on 2026-09-28 explains that the statistics integrate the agricultural and hydrometric information generated in CONAGUA's field of responsibility so that irrigated agricultural production and efficient water use can be monitored under the national water programme, and lists editions for the agricultural years 2005-2006 to 2022-2023 (without 2008 to 2011 and 2012-2013). Such yearbooks report irrigated area, crops, production and yields by state and unit. Coverage is national, by year. Access is free PDF download in Spanish; no licence is stated beyond the portal's general terms. Caveats: tables are in PDF, the latest edition lags by about three years, and definitions may change between editions; the contents were inferred from the page and titles, not from opening a file. It supports capacity planning and drought adaptation studies of Mexican irrigation, such as water demand by region and crop. Related records: data-mexico-conagua-open-data-hydrological-stations-dams-aquifers gives the hydrometric side.
